name: 秒哒
desc: Baidu's no-code platform that turns a sentence into an app
desc_zh: 百度的一句话无代码应用搭建平台
solves: A small internal tool waits weeks for a developer. Describe it in plain words and Miaoda returns a working app.
solves_zh: 想做个内部小工具，排期要等几周。用大白话说清需求，它直接生成能跑的网页、小程序和后台。
best_for: Monday needs a leave-request form and every developer on the team is already booked.
best_for_zh: 周一就要一个请假审批表单，组里开发的排期却已经排满了。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.baidu.com/more/ (Baidu 全部产品目录: “秒哒 一句话做应用”) and the 百度智能云 newsro）。 First announced 2024-11-12 at 百度世界2024 (李彦宏, One More Thing) and fully opened 2025-03-24 at 百度 AI Day; the 2025-03-24 全量上线 day is used as first public availability. Official site spells it miaoda.cn (also www.miaoda.cn); the docs call the product 秒哒公有云 MIAODA. Generates websites, H5, mini-programs, small games and back ends from natural language; the docs also list a 秒哒 APP for Android and iOS, and separate 团队版 / 企业版 editions plus a 商单平台. Outside the 2026-05-07 window: proposed as a backfill, absent from the ledger. Do not confuse with 妙搭 (ByteDance, ledger bytedance-4): same pinyin, different vendor. 首次公开日期来源：https://cloud.baidu.com/news/news_6598ad33-7d5b-40c2-8a89-8325d066f87a
